scientific_limitations: The exact full failure-count law is proved only for the sharply classified multipliers having no forbidden prime. The general arbitrary-multiplier result covers joint failures at indices 2 and 3, not all indices. A published square/gcd criterion is used as a premise.
title: Exact first-two failure frequencies and a sharp stabilization criterion for reciprocal-sum squares
